<reasoning>
[Reason]
The six bench desks form two columns of three workstations, with three task chairs along the accessible south side of each desk. This uses the central floor efficiently while preserving a continuous circulation corridor along the east side for all four east and south doors. Monitors are placed on their assigned desks facing the seated users.

Tall shelves and printer stands are grouped along the solid west wall, while the low credenzas sit beneath the north windows. The collaboration table and its three stools occupy the quieter northwest end of the open area without obstructing the north-side door approach. Wall-mounted whiteboards use open portions of the west wall. Supported printers, plants, documents, and supplies are centered safely within their parent surfaces.
[/Reason]
</reasoning>
